title: Associação Focinho Amigo — API
setup: Supply DATABASE_URL and a random JWT_SECRET of at least 32 bytes through environment variables; .env files are not automatically loaded.
npm run migrate && npm run seed
Set ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_NAME, ADMIN_PASSWORD (12+ characters, at most 72 UTF-8 bytes), then npm run bootstrap-admin; unset ADMIN_PASSWORD afterward.

Docker: use the root compose.yaml and root .env.example. From the repository root, docker compose up --build -d starts PostgreSQL 18, API and nginx; the single API service runs migrations on startup. Run docker compose exec api npm run seed for example animals. Bootstrap via docker compose run --rm -e ADMIN_EMAIL -e ADMIN_NAME -e ADMIN_PASSWORD api npm run bootstrap-admin.
E2E: use a dedicated disposable database and run TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://... npm test. Tests migrate and truncate this database; do not point at production.
npm run check performs JavaScript syntax checks.

security.auth: The Authorization header contains the scheme, a space, then the login token. JWT uses HS256 and expires after 2 hours. Prefer keeping tokens in memory; never commit secrets.
security.cors: One exact CORS_ORIGIN, default http://localhost:5173. No cookies.
security.rateLimits: 300 API requests per 15 minutes; 10 login attempts per 15 minutes; 20 combined public submissions per hour; 30 photo uploads per hour, per IP.
security.proxy: TRUST_PROXY defaults to 0 (disabled); 1 trusts exactly one reverse-proxy hop. Root nginx must overwrite X-Forwarded-For with $remote_addr and the API must not have a publicly reachable host port. Never use trust-all true. An additional upstream TLS/load-balancer proxy requires separately configured trusted IP ranges and real-IP handling at nginx to preserve client identity; do not simply increase hop count or accept untrusted inbound forwarded headers.
security.upload: Multipart field photo only, exactly one file, maximum 5 MB. PNG/JPEG/WebP MIME and signature validation; random server filename; no SVG, original filenames, HTML or directory listing. Files are served with nosniff and restrictive CSP.
security.privacy: Applications and received messages are accessible only to administrators. Public submission responses contain ID/status only. This demo collects contact data; configure consent, retention and access procedures before real deployment.
security.scope: One fictional case-study organization; inquiries only, no payment processing, no real emergency dispatch. Abuse reports should also be directed to local authorities when urgent.

animal.name: string (1..120)
animal.photoUrl: null or relative /uploads/<uuid>.png|jpg|webp, set only by upload

response.organization: name, tagline, description, email, phone, city, isCaseStudy, donationNotice

routes.note: Available animals only; 404 for nonpublic animals.

body.address: optional, max300; required min5 for abuse

routes.body: one or more writable animal fields

routes.note: Deletes photo; keeps applications with animalName snapshot and null animalId.
Approval does not automatically mark an animal adopted; administrator sets animal status separately.

errors.note: Malformed UUID/query/body:400; invalid login including malformed credentials:401; unknown record:404. Unknown body/query fields are rejected.
